∀ (A : ℝ) {ρ v₀ : ℝ},
  0 ≤ ρ →
    ρ < 1 →
      Filter.Tendsto
        (fun k =>
          BfgsVerification.UnexcitedMetric.diagonal A
            ((1 + ρ) / (2 * ρ) * BfgsVerification.UnexcitedMetric.radius ρ v₀ k))
        Filter.atTop (𝓝 (BfgsVerification.UnexcitedMetric.diagonal A 0))

∀ {n : ℕ} (R : BfgsVerification.FullBFGSRun n) (G c : ℝ),
  0 < G →
    0 < c →
      (∀ (k : ℕ), BfgsVerification.sqNorm (R.g k) ≤ G ^ 2) →
        (∀ (k : ℕ), c ≤ R.beta k) →
          BfgsVerification.ScalarHierarchy.NormalizedHierarchy n (fun k => BfgsVerification.principalSum (R.H k)) R.q
            (fun k => R.d k / c) (4 * G ^ 2 / c ^ 2) (G ^ 2)

∀ {n m : ℕ} (H : BfgsVerification.Mat n) (Z : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin m) ℝ) (g y : BfgsVerification.Vec n) (α : ℝ),
  Matrix.IsSymm H →
    α ≠ 0 →
      BfgsVerification.metricEnergy H g ≠ 0 →
        -BfgsVerification.dot y (Matrix.mulVec H g) / BfgsVerification.metricEnergy H g ≠ 0 →
          let q := BfgsVerification.metricEnergy H g;
          let β := -BfgsVerification.dot y (Matrix.mulVec H g) / q;
          Z.transpose * BfgsVerification.inverseBFGS H (BfgsVerification.bfgsStep H g α) y * Z =
            BfgsVerification.CompressionDeterminant.compression (Z.transpose * H * Z)
                (Z.transpose.mulVec (Matrix.mulVec H g)) (Z.transpose.mulVec (Matrix.mulVec H y)) (-β * q)
                (BfgsVerification.dot y (Matrix.mulVec H y)) +
              (α / (β * q)) •
                BfgsVerification.outer (Z.transpose.mulVec (Matrix.mulVec H g)) (Z.transpose.mulVec (Matrix.mulVec H g))
